Steer an explorer in Shiny

Source: R/shiny.R
grafts-proxy.Rd

graftsProxy() points at an explorer drawn by renderGrafts(), to change what it shows or its data from the server, without drawing it again. The explorer reports what it shows back through inputs (see graftsOutput()).

Usage

graftsProxy(outputId, session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain())

grafts_focus(proxy, keys)

grafts_pin(proxy, keys, pinned = TRUE)

grafts_unpin(proxy, keys = NULL)

grafts_view(proxy, view = NULL, set = NULL)

grafts_theme(proxy, theme = c("system", "light", "dark"))

grafts_measure(proxy, measure)

grafts_reset(proxy)

grafts_update(proxy, explorer, lazy = NULL)

Arguments

outputId

The id of the output, as given to graftsOutput() in the same module or app.

session

The Shiny session, by default the one running the server.

proxy

A proxy from graftsProxy().

keys

The series, as a data frame with a column for each key and a row for each series (such as the rows of the explorer's data, or of the input$<id>_focus it reports), or a named list or vector for one series. Keys left out, or NA, are aggregated over: list(State = "NSW") is the total of New South Wales, and list() the total of everything.

pinned

TRUE to pin, FALSE to unpin.

view

The view to show: "grid", "overlay", "stacked" or "season", among those the explorer offers.

set

The series the view draws: the focus's "children" or the "pinned" series.

theme

"system", "light" or "dark".

measure

One of the data's numeric measured variables.

explorer

An explorer from grafts() with the new data.

lazy

Serve each series through the session when it is drawn, rather than writing them all into the page. NULL (the default) serves data with more than 250,000 values.

Details

  • grafts_focus() focuses a series, drawing the splits that reach it.

  • grafts_pin() and grafts_unpin() pin and unpin series. Unpinning with no keys clears every pin.

  • grafts_view() chooses the view and the set of series it draws.

  • grafts_theme() and grafts_measure() choose the theme and measure.

  • grafts_reset() returns the graph to the total.

  • grafts_update() replaces the explorer's data. When the new data have the same series, the graph, focus, pins, views and layout stay as they were, so the visitor sees the numbers change. Otherwise the explorer starts again.

Each returns the proxy, invisibly, so that calls can be piped.

See also

renderGrafts()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
library(shiny)
tourism_agg <- fabletools::aggregate_key(
  tsibble::tourism, Purpose * (State / Region), Trips = sum(Trips)
)
ui <- fluidPage(
  actionButton("nsw", "New South Wales"),
  actionButton("recent", "Last 10 years"),
  graftsOutput("ts")
)
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$ts <- renderGrafts(grafts(tourism_agg))
  observeEvent(input$nsw, {
    graftsProxy("ts") |> grafts_focus(list(State = "New South Wales"))
  })
  observeEvent(input$recent, {
    recent <- tsibble::filter_index(tourism_agg, "2007 Q1" ~ .)
    graftsProxy("ts") |> grafts_update(grafts(recent))
  })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)
}
